title: In the race a driver set the lap record for the Austrian Grand Prix Circuit
question:
In the race a driver set the lap record for the Austrian Grand Prix Circuit, how long did he spent at the pit stop at that same race?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: lap record means the fastest time recorded which refers to time, how long spent at pitstop refers to duration

prediction.sql:
SELECT ps.XCL_054
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
JOIN circuits c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
JOIN pitStops ps ON ps.XCL_049 = lt.XCL_043 AND ps.XCL_050 = lt.XCL_044
WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
  AND lt.XCL_048 = (
    SELECT MIN(lt2.XCL_048)
    FROM lapTimes lt2
    JOIN races r2 ON lt2.XCL_043 = r2.XCL_065
    JOIN circuits c2 ON r2.XCL_068 = c2.XCL_001
    WHERE c2.XCL_003 = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
  )
